prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Create exactly one high fidelity desktop web application UI comp, landscape 1440 × 1000 pixels. This is the actual edge-to-edge application workspace, with no monitor frame, no browser chrome, no scene, no decorative illustration.
Product title Russian exact: "Заявки на мероприятия". Use a disciplined midnight blue #13283e field across the entire application, clear white typography, restrained amber #dfae49 for returned/current stage, approved green #4eaa83. Fine blue-grey rules divide surfaces. Bold coherent dark world. Humanist sans typography, stable legible station labels, sharp purposeful controls.
Top navigation: small product wordmark "Tech Analyst Club", role toggle "Организатор" selected / "Согласующий", note "Локальный прототип". Large heading "Заявки на мероприятия" and primary amber button "+ Новая заявка". Beneath, horizontal stage navigation "Все" selected, "На согласовании", "На доработке", "Подготовка", "Готово". Stage navigation visually inspired by transportation wayfinding discipline: orderly clear functional navigation, no geographic map.
Main workspace starts immediately below navigation and spans the width. Left approximately 60% is a dense readable application registry. Right approximately 40% is the task detail panel for selected application. Registry header "Заявки", small note "Демонстрационные данные". Table columns "Название", "Статус", "Готовность". Three actual demonstration rows only:
"Семинар отдела" — amber badge "На доработке" — "—", clearly selected with amber left rule.
"Встреча клуба" — badge "На согласовании" — "—".
"Конференция команды" — green badge "Согласовано" — text "Осталось 2 из 4", restrained segmented preparation indicator.
Keep registry rows compact but readable, bold titles and plain labels. Clean generous breathing room beneath these three records, no invented data.
Right detail panel has title "Семинар отдела", amber status "На доработке". A simple legible three-station linear progression with actual words "Согласование" then "Доработка" then "Подготовка". A thin route line connects exactly three circular stations; station "Доработка" is amber current, other stages restrained white/bluegrey. No branching network or graphic graph. This is a clear operational stage route, not a decorative subway map. Detail contains "Комментарий согласующего" with exact text "Уточните программу и число участников", amber left hairline. Then label "Название мероприятия" and readable editable field value "Семинар отдела" plus primary button "Отправить повторно". Small supporting line "Исправьте заявку и отправьте на согласование".
Bottom unobtrusive "Демонстрационные данные · Сохранение в этом браузере".
Constraints: Russian text precise and readable, no invented dates, people, metrics or event details. No neon, glow, drop shadows or gradients. No white page/card sea. No hero composition. No geographic map, no ornate decorative symbols. Professionally designed believable production app with legible UI and functional wayfinding hierarchy.
